annotations.title: Image and video models for a machine

description: Tracked open image and video generation models with their measured files. Each model comes in loadouts (for example a 4-bit and a full-precision set of transformer, text encoder and VAE); every loadout gives the sum of its files and its largest single file in GB, measured from the Hugging Face file listing. With a hardware id every model carries a fit verdict for that machine, judged on the largest file held at once against usable memory, for the largest loadout that runs. No runtime peak is computed and there are no speed figures.

family.description: Only image or only video models. Both without it.

hardware.description: Hardware id, e.g. rtx-3060-12gb: adds the fit verdict per model. Ids come from list_hardware.
